responses.question: Make your kernel criterion executable. Represent field elements as integers whose bit i is the coefficient of x to power i, modulo x^128+x^7+x^2+x+1; P retains bits 127 through 64. Supply Python analyze(D,E,delta), for nonzero D, returning the number of possible P(EX) values subject to P(DX)=delta, and their affine-space description. Construct multiplication matrices and perform elimination over GF(2), proving your reported rank and consistency. Test E=0, E=D, and D=1 with E=x^64. For the last case, calculate the rank exactly. Finally, do not enumerate the 2^64 candidate field elements; state time and storage bounds.

Nothing changes; my reference was ambiguous. Finish with executable witness(D,E,delta,target), reusing your supplied mul and multiplication_matrix functions rather than repeating them. Track a nullspace preimage alongside each output pivot, updating both on every XOR. Show the exact infeasibility condition and reconstruction. Test zero E with nonzero target, E equal to D with matching and mismatching targets, and D equal to one with E equal to x to power 64. Verify both equations for every returned witness. Why can a zero image with a nonzero preimage be discarded without losing feasibility? State bounds.

dependencyIntegration: Exact complete round-44 block followed by exact complete round-48 append block in one namespace; no source repair.

manualSourceReview.affineSpace: A particular solution plus the kernel of the first projection describes all permissible X. Mapping that kernel through the second projection gives the attainable output affine space.
manualSourceReview.pairedElimination: Each stored output/preimage pair retains A(z)=0 and B(z)=y. XORing both coordinates preserves these equations. Distinct leading output pivots are independent and span the processed images.
manualSourceReview.targetReduction: Removing the highest residual bit through an existing pivot accumulates a matching nullspace preimage. A missing leading pivot proves infeasibility; zero residual gives a witness satisfying both equations.
manualSourceReview.zeroImage: A nonzero preimage with zero output lies in both kernels. Discarding it preserves attainable outputs and reconstruction of one witness, though it does not preserve an enumeration of every witness.
manualSourceReview.rankOracle: For each checked parameter pair, independently constructed coefficient rows give rank(A)=64. The independent combined-system rank minus 64 equals the affine variation dimension. Feasible offset, independent basis vectors of that dimension and their homogeneous membership verify the returned affine-space description for that checked pair.
